definitions.short: Timnah , the name of two places in Palestine
definitions.full: H8553. Timnah תִּמְנָ֫תָה תִּמְנָה, proper name, of a location (probably = portion, territory ); — ( חִמְנָה Josh 15:10 , 57 ; 2Chr 28:18 ; תִּמְנָ֫תֶה [as nominative see GFM Judg 14:1 ] Josh 19:43 ; Judg 14:1-2 , 5 ; with ה locative תִּמְנָ֫תָה Gen 38:12-13 , 14 ; Judg 14:1 , 5 ; ᵐ5 Θαμνα , Θαμναθα ): — 1 place in hill-country of Judah Gen 38:12-13 , 14 . probably = Josh 15:57 . Site unknown (compare Di Gen 38:12 Rob BR ii. 17 n .). 2 place on border of Judah Josh 15:10 ; 19:43 (assigned to Dan), Judg 14:1 (twice in verse); 14:2 , 5 (twice in verse); 2Chr 28:18 . Modern Tibneh , approximately 15 miles south of west from Jerusalem compare Rob BR ii.17 Buhl Geogr. 196 .
